architecture_summary: A multi-tool AI CLI application written in Go with a SvelteKit web frontend. The core functionality uses pattern-based AI prompting (200+ patterns in data/patterns/) to analyze, extract, summarize, and transform text content. Supports multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, AWS Bedrock, Perplexity, Google Gemini). Includes auxiliary tools for changelog generation, code context extraction, and PDF conversion. The web interface provides a chat UI and pattern browsing. All AI calls are authenticated via environment API keys; the web interface has no authentication layer.
key_patterns: Gin web server for API routes
Git-based changelog generation with merge detection
GitHub API integration for releases and PRs
